snippet.title: VoxelMancy
snippet.description:
The game/tool - https://reuniko.itch.io/voxelmancy

Voxelmancy is what happens when Minecraft meets Blender — but with way more creative freedom.
Build together in real time on a shared multiplayer world — no servers to host, no mods to install. Just one persistent universe where everyone can create side by side.

Shape voxels with precision tools, using over 1600 realistic materials and a library of shared user-made prefabs. Export your creations to FBX and drop them into Unity, Unreal, or Blender — perfect for prototyping levels, environments, or game assets.

It’s a powerful creative sandbox, a multiplayer builder’s dream, and an MMO for makers — all in one.
